item.title: ShikataLab - The Data Story: Stretching OCI's Free Tier
item.description: Oracle’s free tier is generous with compute and weirdly stingy with disk, and that combination has shaped every storage decision in my homelab. This is the data story: what the limits actually are, the three ways I worked around them, and what’s still missing. The problem: every gigabyte counts The hard limit is 200GB of boot volume, total, across every instance in the tenancy. My main box (azamilab0, the k3s node) has a 153GB boot volume.
